segments.arabic: النّجّار. ذكرها ابن حبيب في المبايعات، وقال ابن سعد: هي ابنة أخي سعد بن زرارة، وأمها مخزومية، تزوّجها علقمة بن عمرو بن يغوث بن مالك بن مبذول، وأسلمت عمرة وبايعت.
segments.english: al-Najjar. Ibn Habib mentioned her among the women who pledged allegiance. Ibn Sa'd said: She was the daughter of the brother of Sa'd ibn Zurara, and her mother was a woman of Makhzum. Alqama ibn Amr ibn Yaghuth ibn Malik ibn Mabdhul married her. Amra embraced Islam and pledged allegiance.

names.english: Amra bint Mas'ud ibn Qays ibn Amr ibn Zayd Manat ibn Adi ibn Amr ibn Malik ibn al-Najjar
